description: Language-neutral golden vectors for the money twin (pkg/hub/money <-> @alloy/sdk/money). All numeric inputs and outputs are strings to avoid JSON float precision loss. Error cases are matched by error identity (Go exception sentinel / TS MoneyError.code), never message text. See conformance/README.md.
